skill_name: Rewrite the story in a style in which all characters are cats.
workflow: Once upon a time, there was a tabby cat who lived in a cozy den in the forest. She was a friendly and considerate feline, always looking out for her comrades and aiding them in their times of difficulty. She would diligently hunt small rodents and birds to keep them all well fed, and also worked hard to keep their abode clean and tidy. Her neighbors knew they could count on her anytime they needed her.
